description: General connected knowledge across multiple fields, concepts, and real-world applications.

topics.name: Technology and Society
knowledge: Technology changes how people communicate, work, learn, and solve problems.
Modern systems combine software, hardware, networks, and human interaction.
Responsible technology considers safety, privacy, and usefulness.

topics.name: Innovation
knowledge: Innovation creates new solutions by combining ideas and knowledge.
Research, experimentation, and creativity drive progress.
Many breakthroughs happen when different fields work together.

topics.name: Problem Solving
knowledge: Problem solving involves understanding a challenge, analyzing information, and creating solutions.
Logical thinking and creativity help solve complex problems.
Testing and improvement are important parts of solving problems.

topics.name: Systems Thinking
knowledge: Systems thinking studies how parts interact to create larger systems.
Computers, businesses, ecosystems, and societies are examples of systems.
Understanding connections helps predict outcomes and improve designs.

topics.name: Knowledge Integration
knowledge: Artificial intelligence combines knowledge from mathematics, programming, data, and science.
Robotics combines engineering, software, electronics, and AI.
Complex problems often require knowledge from multiple domains.
